separate_dependency_decision.reason: An unmarked unit name is appropriate when a content description identifies a measurement scale rather than appending a unit to a number. The new short Pluma label supplies positive support for singular pixels in this register. Its margin mistranslation, alternate spelling and separated preposition limit its weight. AOSP supports the selected stem in a megapixel compound; the singular and original -och plural are a transparent morphological family. The new construction evidence and source context make this revision defensible without claiming that the plural was wrong.

grammar_contract.case_number_agreement: No numeral, adjective or determiner in the template creates a count agreement obligation. The singular is used as an unmarked measure name; the plural remains admissible.
grammar_contract.noun_order: dimension first, prepositional measurement-scale phrase second
grammar_contract.label_ellipsis: No finite verb or copula is required by this field-label context; actual published short heading supplies direct precedent.
grammar_contract.percent_denominator: Width uses original.width and height uses original.height in DimensionControls; translation adds no denominator, numerical value, 100%-ceiling or image-area meaning.
